name: Numbuh 404
source:
Name: Anabelle [REDACTED]

Designation: Numbuh 404

Sector: G

Position: Comms Officer


Numbuh 404 isn't much for privacy...well, not the privacy of others. Her paranoia and curiosity lead her to engage in near constant surveillance of anything and everything she can. 

She tends to be reclusive and might occasionally come off as mean spirited, but she (usually) means well.


"My surname is none of your concern, you intrusive dullard!"
